'''Naand''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and a member of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a pirate gang active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Most of the pirates in the Brotherhood, including the leader, were fond of the annual [[Festival]] held in [[Tolea Biqua]], which was near the pirate base in asteroid [[L-7]]. Commonly, the majority of the pirates enjoyed the party. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Naand and two other pirates, [[Triven]] and [[Ytram]] were ordered to remain in L-7 during the Festival, as a skeleton crew, much to their chagrin.
